217615.name: Lubavitch Outreach
217615.note: First mention of the outreach division under its director: Lubavitch of Michigan's staff list in the Jewish News, May 15 1987: 'COMMUNITY OUTREACH Rabbi Yosef Y. Keselman'; again 'Yosef Y. Keselman, outreach director' (Nov 27 1987), 'Rabbi Y. Y. Keselman, Outreach' (Nov 1989, Sept 1990), 'Community Outreach Director Rabbi Yosef Y. Keselman' (Dec 1990, Feb 1991). Later named as a center: 'Rabbi Shneur Keselman of the Chabad Lubavitch Outreach Center in Oak Park' (Jewish News, 21 Jan 2000); 'Oak Park Chabad Lubavitch Outreach, Director: Rabbi Yosef Keselman' (25 May 2001); Rabbi Yitzchok Mann at 23160 Gardner Street by Dec 2009 (lubavitch.com's directory). A first mention of the same work under the same director, not a founding report, so medium. (Rabbi Keselman had earlier opened a Chabad House of Troy/Royal Oak, Sept 1978.) Its chabad.org listing went up on Nov 1 2004.

4040602.name: Royal Oak Chabad Jewish Center
4040602.note: Nov 2018: the Royal Oak Jewish Center newly opened by Rabbi Moishie and Mushky Glitsenstein (myjewishdetroit.org); the July 2024 Jewish News list also gives 2018. Not the first Chabad there: the Jewish News, Sept 15 1978 ('New Chabad House Opens'): 'Rabbi Joseph I. Keselman will head a new branch of Chabad Lubavitch for residents of Troy and Royal Oak' (at Congregation Beth Achim); listed as Chabad House of Troy/Royal Oak, 1905 W. 14 Mile Rd., in 1980-81 (https://digital.bentley.umich.edu/djnews/djn.1978.09.15.001/21).

4428829.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Troy
4428829.note: March 2020: Chana Caytak moved back to Metro Detroit 'last year' and opened the Chabad Jewish Center of Troy with her husband, Rabbi Menachem Caytak (Jewish News); Nov 2021: 'more than two years after opening'.
